notes_for_editor: Brief values not confirmed by any fetched page: built 2004, height 30 m, elevation 653 m, status standing, access closed. The Alberta layer (MapServer/0) has YEAR_CONSTRUCTED and TOWER_HEIGHT fields, but its query endpoint timed out twice, so no Zama row was read. firelookout.ca has no Zama page (404). The Canada Lookouts Zama page gives only the name and division. 'Alberta Wildfire' as agency comes from the brief only, so it is left out of facts. The 2012 fire is area context; no source ties the lookout to it. Story is short because the evidence is thin; expand only if the Zama row of the Alberta layer can be read.
